label: Liquidity pool below (sellside) intact (3, 0.1 ATR)
gloss: whether the nearest sellside liquidity pool below price survived this bar: false only on the bar whose close is below it, which retires it — a sellside pool forms on the bar that confirms an equal low — a recorded pivot low of length 3 within 0.1 × ATR(200) of the previous recorded one, the EQL rule — at the newer pivot's price, and stays intact until a close below it retires it; several pools are kept at once — computed by the server over this timeframe’s bars, in Smart Money Concepts legs: a pivot high of length n is a high above every high of the n bars after it, a pivot low a low below every low of the n bars after it, recorded alternately as the leg turns; absent when no pool is intact, and absent where a pool formed before the bars read prove the equal pivots could be nearer, so it can read absent while price trades beyond every close the bars read since then

equalBars.description: The equal highs and lows’ pivot length, each side.

equalThreshold.description: How close two pivots must be to be equal, as a fraction of ATR(200) at the deciding bar.
